english.title: Allow person under 18 to go abroad to perform for profit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[, having responsibility for a child, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed him]_
(B)_[, having responsibility for a child, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..), allowed her]_
(C)_[caused a child, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..)]_
(D)_[procured a child, namely **(..SPECIFY CHILD..)]_

to go abroad for the purpose of

(E)_[singing, playing, performing, or being exhibited, for profit]_
(F)_[taking part in a sport where payment in respect of his doing so was made to him or another person]_
(G)_[taking part in a sport where payment in respect of her doing so was made to her or another person]_
(H)_[working as a model where payment in respect of his doing so was made to him or another person]_
(I)_[working as a model where payment in respect of her doing so was made to her or another person]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 26 of the Children and Young Persons Act 1933.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
contravened section 25(1) CYPA 1933
allowed the child to go abroad

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
